A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same UDM-GRPO work, with complete main text and Appendices A–C. Text, equations, tables and figures support reliable comparison; rasterized figure labels in v3 remain visually readable.

before.justification: v1 reports original URSA fine-tuning results and ablations in Section 5, plus FUDOKI experiments in Appendix C.1 and Table 4.

after.justification: v3 retains the original URSA and FUDOKI experimental results, ablations, distribution analysis and qualitative evaluations.

M1.justification: Sections 4.2–4.4 and Algorithm 1 retain the same final-clean-sample actions, forward-process trajectories, Reduced-Step optimization and CFG-Free training. The shortened introduction does not change the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions retain compositional generation, human preference alignment and text rendering through the same GenEval, PickScore and OCR experiments. Appendix B uses the same pretraining data, and the qualitative test prompts are retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 1–4 and the qualitative comparisons. Both retain the same continuous and discrete baselines, including Flow-GRPO and Mask-GRPO comparisons, and the same URSA ablation variants.

E3.justification: URSA retains 16 groups of eight samples and 10 sampling/25 evaluation steps. FUDOKI retains 15/32 steps, while Appendix B retains 2,048 caption–image pairs and the same FID procedure. Metrics and experimental settings are unchanged.

E4.justification: Both include the same action, trajectory, CFG and timestep-selection ablations, entropy/FID analysis, and qualitative training progression. Appendices B–C add or remove no analyses or case studies.

E5.justification: The point-estimate tables and training-curve displays are unchanged. Neither version provides stated repeated-run counts, seed details, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: All entries in Tables 1–4 match, including UDM-GRPO's 0.96 GenEval, 23.81 PickScore and 0.57 OCR in Table 2. Plotted findings and qualitative examples are retained; image resampling does not introduce different results.

T1.justification: The probability-path definitions, MDP formulations, policy objectives and mathematical reasoning in Sections 3–4, including Equations 1–11, are unchanged. No assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same novelty, stability, efficiency and performance claims. The condensed introduction preserves the meaning and scope of the two stability strategies.

C2.justification: Both retain the same explanations involving inaccurate intermediate actions, trajectory distribution shift and CFG-related exploration. OCR qualifications, FUDOKI applicability claims, and future work on video generation and multiple rewards also remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 5.1 and Appendices A–C retain the same optimizer settings, hardware, sampling details, pseudocode and FID computation instructions. The code-access link is unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the bibliography retain the same cited works and positioning relative to prior diffusion and reinforcement-learning methods. The new conference notice changes publication metadata only.

P1.justification: v3 condenses one introduction paragraph describing the two stability strategies and replaces the preprint notice with ICML proceedings information. Section order and the remaining scientific narrative are retained.

P2.justification: v3 adds running-title headers and minor text reflow. Several figures have resolution or embedding changes, including rasterization of Figure 10, while retaining their panels, examples and captions. Table structures are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 chiefly shortens one introductory paragraph and updates publication formatting. Tables 1–4, methods, analyses and reproducibility information remain unchanged. The limited concision gain and figure-resolution changes do not materially alter clarity or evidential support, yielding no meaningful net quality difference.
